name: UOnlineAccountCommon::LoginStep_LoggingIn

findings.evidence: Read account `+0x140` identity. If null, invoke account virtual `+0x300(account, 0x19, &global_1480e8e90, empty FString)`, clean up the string and return. The global's actual meaning and the virtual implementation are unresolved.

Local user number is the int32 at `*(account+0x20)+0xb8`, or `-1` when account `+0x20` is null. Call identity virtual `+0x118` with it. This matches `IOnlineIdentity::GetLoginStatus(int32)` and status 2 matches logged-in.

For status 2, reload identity `+0x140`, call its virtual `+0xf0` with user number, matching `GetUniquePlayerId(int32)`. If the returned shared pointer is null, invoke account virtual `+0x300(account, 0, &global_1480e8f68, FString("InvalidUser"))`. Otherwise emit the already-logged-in log at verbosity >= 6, invoke account virtual `+0x3f8(account, user number, unique ID)`, then call `0x1410c3c30(account, global_1480e8a68)` to schedule continuation. Release the shared pointer. The virtual target and error global remain unresolved.

For other statuses, create a weak-account delegate targeting `0x1410db150` (completion signature local user, success, unique ID, error), call identity virtual `+0x70` with user number and delegate, matching `AddOnLoginCompleteDelegate_Handle`, and pass its returned handle with the local-user key to `0x1410bc670(account+0x528, &localUser, &handle)`. Destroy the temporary delegate. The insertion/replacement and ownership semantics of helper `0x1410bc670` have not been established. Its order before Login/AutoLogin matters, including for synchronous callbacks.

If int32 at account `+0x280` is greater than 1, emit headless-credentials log at verbosity >= 6, then invoke reloaded identity virtual `+0x68` with user number and credentials at account `+0x258`. Otherwise, if int32 at `+0x220` is greater than 1, emit regular-credentials log at verbosity >= 6, then call the same virtual with credentials at `+0x1f8`. Otherwise emit no-valid-credentials log at verbosity >= 6 and invoke reloaded identity virtual `+0xd8` with user number. These match `IOnlineIdentity::Login` and `AutoLogin`; return values are discarded. Both credential structures match `FOnlineAccountCredentials` Type/Id/Token FString fields in local engine source; the tested offsets are the Token FString's array count, so count > 1 is a nonempty token in the normal FString representation. The headless log reads the regular credential Type at `+0x1f8`, not headless Type. The regular log reads Type and Id. No credential values are captured here.

unresolved: Delegate handle-map helper semantics, error globals, complete identity provider behavior, exact credential production and original runtime account wiring remain unresolved. Username alone does not select Login: nonempty credential Token selects headless/regular Login; otherwise original invokes AutoLogin. A selected local account snapshot does not prove successful original identity login.
verification: Static decompilation/instruction and current Engine interface review only. No complete C++ lift of the original step, native build or runtime test.
callback_entry_observation: Completion callback 0x1410db150 logs, looks up its local-user key in account+0x528, and when found clears the identity completion delegate via virtual +0x78 if identity exists, then removes the key through 0x1410e5f90 before further completion handling. The exact map helper semantics are not established here.
